summary: Revised Phase 2 Implementation Plan and Architecture Specification for Natkhat Café migration to Supabase PostgreSQL and Vercel Node.js Serverless Functions. Incorporates strictly verified SQLite database inventory (checksum, exact row counts, 6 orders reconciled, items_json structure), final PostgreSQL Drizzle schema using BIGINT for monetary fields, complete executable RLS SQL policies, fail-closed RBAC middleware, secure admin provisioning, Vercel function runtime architecture, exhaustive API contract mapping, and a reversible migration and verification protocol.
